rows.grounds: locative of the proper name Madana, specifying the mountain
locative noun in apposition to madane
adjective agreeing with parvate in the locative
optative verb fused with enclitic ca; sandhi/junction marked in the given token
accusative object of paśyet, denoting the deity to be beheld

items.question: What sacred vision must be sought after reaching the delightful Madana mountain?
premises: One should go to the delightful Madana mountain.
Arrival at that place precedes the prescribed act.
The prescribed act is to behold Śaṅkara.
items.inference: Reaching the delightful Madana mountain is enjoined as the occasion for obtaining a vision of Śaṅkara.
uncertainties: The specific geographical identity of Madana mountain is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Having gone to the delightful Madana mountain, one should also behold Śaṅkara.
